name: room_tone
desc: Fluorescent hum, CRT whine, air and distant traffic. 24 s seamless loop.

name: room_clock_tick
desc: Wall clock, tick half. Recorded.

name: room_clock_tock
desc: Wall clock, tock half: the same tick a little lower. Alternate with tick.

name: room_look_left
desc: Soft whoosh, turning left to the TV.

name: room_look_right
desc: Soft whoosh, turning right to the machine.

name: ui_hover
desc: Tiny CRT blip when the pointer lands on something.

name: ui_menu_move
desc: Menu selection moves.

name: ui_menu_confirm
desc: Menu select: two blips up.

name: ui_menu_back
desc: Back or cancel: two blips down.

name: ui_slider_tick
desc: One notch on the CRT strength or volume slider.

name: desk_tickets_print
desc: Dot-matrix printer chatter as the week's tickets come in. Recorded.

name: desk_cash_register
desc: Old cash register: keys, bell, drawer. Recorded.

name: desk_calendar_flip
desc: Calendar page turns to the new week. Recorded.

name: desk_inspection_stamp
desc: Rubber stamp thuds on an inspection week.

name: desk_supplier_phone
desc: Supplier: recorded handset pick-up, a short mumble down the line, recorded hang-up.

name: desk_bribe
desc: Bribe: an envelope slides across the desk, coins drop into a pile. Recorded.

name: desk_shred
desc: Shred: a recorded office shredder bites the paper, runs, and stops.

name: desk_card_lost
desc: Hand full: the new card is crumpled (recorded), with a low falling buzz.

name: desk_denied
desc: Dull thunk: that action is not allowed.

name: live_switch
desc: Heavy go-live toggle: a recorded switch with a synthesised body thunk under it.

name: live_relay
desc: ON AIR relay clicks in (recorded) and the sign starts to buzz.

name: live_onair_sting
desc: Short studio sting from the TV as the show goes live: da-DAH.

name: machine_spin_loop
desc: Ball machine: blower and rattling balls. 4 s seamless loop.

name: machine_digit_flip_1
desc: One flap of the number drum, variant 1. Fire at 12 fps, rotating variants.

name: machine_digit_flip_2
desc: One flap of the number drum, variant 2. Fire at 12 fps, rotating variants.

name: machine_digit_flip_3
desc: One flap of the number drum, variant 3. Fire at 12 fps, rotating variants.

name: machine_lock
desc: The number locks: ratchet, then a heavy clunk. The on-air clock starts here.

name: rig_card_feed
desc: Punch card feeds through the reader, about 0.6 s.

name: rig_undo
desc: Undo: the card is pulled back out of the reader.

name: rig_number_snap
desc: The board result updates: a quick two-step chirp.

name: rig_illegal
desc: Buzzer: that card would leave 00-99, is not whole, or breaks the inspection limit.

name: rig_timer_tick
desc: Timer tick, last 5 seconds at 2 Hz.

name: rig_timer_tick_final
desc: Final second tick, higher and brighter.

name: rig_dead_air
desc: Dead-air hiss from the TV once the target passes. 3 s seamless loop.

name: stall_bad_joke
desc: Host tells a bad joke, rimshot, one lone cough in the audience.

name: stall_sponsor
desc: Cheesy sponsor jingle on marimba and glockenspiel, with a breathless tagline.

name: stall_interview
desc: Confused audience interview: a question, a long uncertain answer, murmuring.

name: stall_panic
desc: Studio panic: shuffling feet, a dropped clipboard, a mic bump, a frantic whisper.

name: announce_button
desc: Big red button: a recorded press and release, with a synthesised low thump for weight.

name: announce_static
desc: Channel-change static, about 0.3 s, hard cut. Mid-brightness, no harsh top.

name: broadcast_theme
desc: Short gaudy game-show theme as the broadcast opens.

name: result_clean
desc: Clean draw: big fanfare, timpani, crowd cheer, ticker beeps.

name: result_small
desc: Small winner: a polite ding-ding and thin, recorded polite applause. Got away with it.

name: result_scandal
desc: Scandal: the crowd gasps, a low stinger, a sad trombone, then a newsroom alarm.

name: result_live_bonus
desc: Live bonus +20: bright chime run with a coin sparkle.

name: result_streak_1
desc: Clean streak goes up to 1. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_streak_2
desc: Clean streak goes up to 2. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_streak_3
desc: Clean streak goes up to 3. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_streak_4
desc: Clean streak goes up to 4. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_streak_5
desc: Clean streak goes up to 5. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_streak_6
desc: Clean streak goes up to 6+. Pitch rises a whole tone per step.

name: result_cash_tick
desc: One tick of the cash counting down after a payout. Repeat fast.

name: result_reveal_beep
desc: Two teletext beeps as the monitor shows the best route.

name: end_signal_loss
desc: Bankrupt: picture collapses with a falling thwip and a pop, then the tube hums down.

name: end_stand_by_tone
desc: "PLEASE STAND BY" 1 kHz test tone through the TV. 2 s seamless loop.

name: end_finale_fanfare
desc: Week 12 survived: long fanfare with a key change, timpani, cheering and applause.

name: end_count_up_tick
desc: One tick of the final cash counting up on the end card.

name: menu_tv_power_on
desc: TV powers on for the start screen: a recorded CRT degauss, plus the rising flyback whine.
